protocol.instances_file: eval/data/bench450.jsonl (FIRST 150 INSTANCES ONLY — CPU runtime cap)

protocol.sampler: move_planner.evaluate.benchmark sampling loop (one random.Random(seed) consumed sequentially over boards, per_board draws per board via sample_instance)
protocol.d_star: exact move-optimal cost returned by sample_instance (move_planner.oracle.solve); reference only, never used at inference

protocol.command: scratch run_anytime_150.py == eval.compare --backward-anytime --device cpu on instances[:150] of eval/data/bench450.jsonl
protocol.expansion_definition: one popped search node whose children are generated (= 1 policy pass + 1 batched value pass over <= k children, in both systems)
